raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father as John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute (who was actually his grandfather), by misreading the Wikipedia snippet that clearly named his father as John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart. This led the process to retrieve and finalize the grandfather’s death date (16 November 1814) instead of the father’s correct death date (22 January 1794).
